challanSteps: Log in at the e-Filing portal, with TAN as User ID.
Go to e-File → e-Pay Tax → New Payment.
Choose Income-tax Act, 2025 for transactions from 1-4-2026. Choose Income-tax Act, 1961 (Challan 281) for transactions up to 31-3-2026.
Select Tax Year 2026-27 and the Pay TDS/TCS card.
Select Major Head, Minor Head and residential status of the deductee.
Under section-wise details, choose the payment description and add the amount. Check the 4-digit code shown.
Complete payment and keep the challan for the return.
majorHeads: Deductee or collectee is a company
Individual, HUF, firm, LLP, AOP, BOI and others
minorHeads: Regular assessment – raised by the department
Demand from a notice or order
challanNotes: Pay separately for company and non-company deductees, and for resident and non-resident deductees.
In-kind codes 1034, 1038, 1059 and 1061: Tax Deducted, Tax Deposited and rate are reported as 0.00 in the return, and a minor head 100 challan is linked. Protean format v1.2.
